items.title: Ernest "Punch" Miller Interview, 1959-09-01
items.q: Now, you take, well, we'd call them the Zulu band. They had a hot brass band, see? Black Benny, myself, Lewis, and what does Tramon play our name? Eddie Morris. Not Eddie Morris. Morris. Morris. Morris French. Morris French played Tramon with Rene.

ctx.x: Back to those brass bands here. Well, the Silverleaf brass band, they wouldn't really be playing too much music then, huh? No. Well. They'd be faking a lot of it, huh? Yeah.

Silverleaf had some good musicians. Tuxedo had some good musicians. Now, you take, well, we'd call them the Zulu band. They had a hot brass band, see? Black Benny, myself, Lewis, and what does Tramon play our name? Eddie Morris. Not Eddie Morris. Morris. Morris. Morris French. Morris French played Tramon with Rene. Yeah. items.title: Ernest "Punch" Miller Interview, 1958-05-24
items.q: Well, there was a fellow named Morris French.

ctx.x: Oh, well, so you know anybody better start with, Buck. That's Bill's favorite, you know. And who did you like trombone?
Trombone? Well, there was a fellow named Morris French.
